feature_scope_from_documentation_and_sta.pki_setup: python Start_Nexus_Office.py --setup-signing creates .nexus-office-python and installs pyHanko==0.31.0. Initial installation requires network access. This verification did not run it.
feature_scope_from_documentation_and_sta.hosted_pages_limit: Code requires a per-launch token and 127.0.0.1 host for local health; API paths are same-origin /api/office/*. A hosted static Pages launch does not provide the helper or PKI backend.
feature_scope_from_documentation_and_sta.pki_limits: Signatures use SHA-256 CMS; no online revocation check or trusted timestamp. Certificate identity is transmitted to the loopback service, temporarily materialized, then deleted by its TemporaryDirectory cleanup. No signing was performed in this verification.
feature_scope_from_documentation_and_sta.retained_originals: Imported original bytes are stored in collective project state for download/preview. Macro content is preserved in the original, not run as VBA/ActiveX.
feature_scope_from_documentation_and_sta.fidelity_limits: Advanced layout, fonts, objects, animation, encryption and version differences can prevent complete fidelity; no universal format support claim is justified.
